captions.summary: [sbc_ppc] Conjugate-Gaussian toy: known-good model passes the SBC rank-uniformity test (p = 0.092), and the known-bad models are ['inadequate_sbc_failed', 'inadequate_sbc_failed']. The replicated-data PPC over frozen discrepancies is adequate_conditional (model/transfer-conditional adequacy, NOT model truth). SBC is computation calibration; the residual check is a separate plug-in type. No detection.
